observations: Three photos show the same black Yamaha electronic keyboard, photographed from different angles on artificial grass.
Front panel text reads 'YAMAHA' and 'PortaSound' (visible photo 2, bottom left corner).
A faint 'PSS-' prefix model number appears in photo 0 near the top left keys, but the full model number is not legible in any photo.
Keyboard has 2-3 octaves of full-size and some narrower keys, multiple sliders, buttons labeled 'MULTI MENU', 'ORCHESTRA', 'AUTO BASS CHORD', etc.
Visible general wear: slight yellowing on white keys, light scuffing on the casing edges, watermark text overlays ('POSTED ON JIJI', 'MARY OLUGBAMI') obscuring parts of the panel.
No power cable, adapter, or battery compartment is visible in any photo.
No photo shows the unit powered on, no screen lit, no sound indicator active.
No photo shows the underside, serial plate, or rear ports (DC in, headphone, MIDI).

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: No photo demonstrates the keyboard powering on, producing sound, or key responsiveness; 'quality/good' is a subjective claim with no supporting proof.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have internal electronic faults
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the unit plugged in, powered on, screen lit, and a key being pressed with audible sound

risks.risk: Missing power adapter/cord, which is often sold separately and affects usability
risks.proof: A photo showing the power adapter/cord included with the unit

risks.risk: Sticky, dead, or non-responsive keys not visible in static photos
risks.proof: A video panning across all keys being pressed in sequence
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming some keys may be faulty

risks.risk: Speaker or sound output could be damaged/crackling
risks.proof: Audio/video clip of the built-in speaker playing a demo tone or song

risks.risk: Model identity unclear, which affects feature set and comparable pricing (number of keys, voices, auto-accompaniment rhythms)
risks.proof: A close-up, unobstructed photo of the full model number plate, usually near the Yamaha logo or on the rear
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of generic Yamaha PortaSound-type keyboards

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the full model number plate (near Yamaha logo or rear panel)
Video of the keyboard powered on, with keys pressed and sound audible
Photo of the included power adapter/cord
Photo of the rear panel showing ports and serial sticker
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Yamaha PortaSound-type children's keyboard by visible branding, but no proof of power-on, sound, or key function is shown, so it must be priced at worst case (untested/possibly non-functional) until a power-on/sound video and clear model plate photo are provided.
